android.desc:
Introducing the aicataloguer app, your go-to tool for efficient product cataloguing. Designed exclusively for aicataloguer web service users, this app simplifies the photo capture and renaming process, making it faster and easier to upload your product images for AI-generated descriptions on our site.

Key Features:

- Custom Camera Functionality: Tailored for optimal product photography, our app ensures you capture the best possible images of your items.
- Dual Photo Capture: Our unique approach allows you to take two photos for each product - one for the general view and another for detailed shots, ensuring comprehensive coverage for cataloguing.
- Automatic Photo Renaming: Eliminate the hassle of manual file sorting. Our app automatically renames and organizes your photos based on your predefined settings, readying them for upload to the aicataloguer platform.
- User-friendly Interface: Designed with efficiency in mind, the app's intuitive interface enables quick and easy product photography, suitable for all skill levels.

The aicataloguer app is the perfect companion for users of our AI cataloguing web service, streamlining the initial steps of capturing and preparing your product images. By enhancing the photo shooting and renaming process, we make it easier for you to leverage the power of AI on the aicataloguer site to generate detailed product descriptions.

We are thrilled to launch aicataloguer v1.0.0 and invite you to experience the convenience it brings to your cataloguing workflow. Your feedback is invaluable to us as we continually seek to improve and tailor our services to meet your needs.

quotes.text:
Hello HN,

I’m happy to share my first Android app called "AICataloguer app", a photo rename camera app specifically designed for taking photos of products. The app allows users to set a "vendor number" and a "lot number", then capture two images of the same product. Each image is saved with a custom name based on the input vendor and lot number.

Features:
 • Set a vendor number and a lot number before taking photos.
 • Capture two images of the same product.
 • Automatically save images with custom names based on the provided vendor and lot numbers.

What I'm Looking For:

I would greatly appreciate your help in testing the app for:
 • Compatibility issues
 • Crashes and errors
 • UI problems
 • Any other feedback or suggestions

How to Join:

The app will be free, but I am still in the testing stage. If you’re willing to test the app, I will need your email to add you to the Google Play testers list. Once added, you can download and test the app.

Link to the app: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.irishaicreative.aicataloguer

Note: If you have not been manually added to the tester list, you won’t be able to view the app through the link and will be redirected to the store with an error message.

To join the testing, please comment your email below or email me directly at support@aicataloguer.com.

Thanks all for your time and future feedback!
quotes.title: New Android App: Photo Rename Camera App – Looking for Testers
